findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / full accounting: Seven RP frontiers all OPEN; no effect-by-effect owner/path/disposition register has been

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Seven RP frontiers all OPEN; no effect-by-effect owner/path/disposition register has been populated. VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE and PROVEN_INDEPENDENT appear only as instructions, not actual accepted disposition rows.

findings.impact: No full direct/transitive closure or complete planned change set. The pack explicitly blocks code.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery: Actual Logistics manifest reverse dependency closure includes direct dependents: admin_das

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Actual Logistics manifest reverse dependency closure includes direct dependents: admin_dashboard, automation, claims, commission, crm_bridge, documents, documents_native, security_base; CRM sync is downstream through security_base/crm_bridge. The file map is limited to four existing addons and does not disposition these consumers individually.

findings.impact: Transitive effect paths and exclusions are incomplete, including legal claim automation and transaction-derived dashboards.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / change planning: Existing delivery-order and pickup/delivery BOL QWeb layouts dereference doc

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Existing delivery-order and pickup/delivery BOL QWeb layouts dereference doc.sale_order_id.company_id, while the selected contract permits real buyerless/company-known loads. All three report files are absent from the detailed file plan.

findings.impact: Buyerless physical paperwork may show missing/wrong source company or fail its intended audience semantics; carrier packet proofs incomplete.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / evidence-backed exclusions: Existing carrier dispatch/delivery/BOL email templates use object

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Existing carrier dispatch/delivery/BOL email templates use object.sale_order_id.company_id for email-from, names, and reply-to context. The map defaults Automation to untouched, and its specific templates have no accepted no-change disposition.

findings.impact: New buyerless/PO-only load messages may use blank or fallback business identity; audience/security and deliverability can diverge from Logistics.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / planning: Linda inbound automation filters mail

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Linda inbound automation filters mail.message.model only to purchase.order and sale.order. Adding a booking request and modifying linda_response.py alone does not deliver booking-bound messages into the evidence pipeline. The inbound XML is not in the file map.

findings.impact: Booking reply evidence is silently absent even when response model accepts the new source kind.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / implementation planning: The active dispatch-acknowledgment cron invokes load

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The active dispatch-acknowledgment cron invokes load.action_send_dispatch_direct() after the threshold, resending the full carrier packet. The accepted Linda/Documents owner policy says packet acknowledgment reminders must not resend the full packet. RP-03 names cron generically but does not assign the exact correction and pre-code proof.

findings.impact: Real duplicate carrier packets, potentially including stale booking revision, can escape without a complete plan.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / planning: The separate plasticos

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The separate plasticos.dispatch transition writes state directly; load_bulk_update_wizard directly invokes load._transition; composer and direct send actions remain distinct. The package does not list each effective entrypoint with change/no-change and an exact enforcement hook.

findings.impact: An Export booking hold may be bypassed by a direct/wizard/cron or mail path.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / exclusions: Freight RFQ creation requires both load company and load

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Freight RFQ creation requires both load company and load.transaction_id; SAL resolver and freight history also derive company/repeat-stream context from SO/transaction. These consumers are not individually disposed in the file-change map.

findings.impact: Buyerless or PO-only loads may encounter an unplanned abstention, blocked RFQ or incorrect freight-source identity.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / downstream consumers: The Claims addon hooks plasticos

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The Claims addon hooks plasticos.document.create and auto-creates a claim and outgoing notification for certain document tags; it searches a transaction via load_id with limit=1. The owner plan does not give Claims a verified no-change or planned adaptation for many scoped evidence links.

findings.impact: One original/typed association migration may spur unintended claim side effects or misattribute claims; evidence changes have monetary/workflow ramifications.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / exclusions: Commission sales dashboard uses a SQL transaction/load join and derives document status fr

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Commission sales dashboard uses a SQL transaction/load join and derives document status from verified/override flags, while proposed Documents replaces unscoped verification with typed scoped acceptance. The pack lacks a per-consumer change/no-change verdict.

findings.impact: Sales dashboard document status or source permissions may diverge even if Export itself displays correct scoped evidence.

findings.title: Blast-radius discovery / planning: The Documents addon has an active six-hour missing-doc cron driven by transaction create_d

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The Documents addon has an active six-hour missing-doc cron driven by transaction create_date and a single-link compliance API that checks expiry but not current/superseded status; these exact data/cron consumers do not have a row-level change/no-change plan.

findings.impact: New scoped evidence may not clear existing reminders or may incorrectly mark old obligations satisfied; duplicative followups are possible.

findings.title: Change planning / security: The global Load rule accepts company_id=False, and the Sales Rep rule keys visibility to s

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The global Load rule accepts company_id=False, and the Sales Rep rule keys visibility to sale_order_id.user_id. Company ownership change and buyerless loads can alter access while no actual-company backfill census or exact revised record rules exist.

findings.impact: Cross-company/missing-company load visibility and owner access are not proven safe.

findings.title: Full change accounting / security: ACL grants base

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: ACL grants base.group_user broad document create/write/unlink, while document.write accepts verified/override fields without enforcing the named manager-authoritative action; the candidate one-writer migration has no precise authorization/field-write migration and negative acceptance row.

findings.impact: A new typed business verifier could be bypassed by ordinary ORM writes, compromising verification authority.

findings.title: Complete implementation planning: M0-M7 migration steps and EE-01

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: M0-M7 migration steps and EE-01..09 tests are desired proof plans, all NOT_RUN. Source counts, actual ambiguous-row populations, exact versioned migration paths (<next_version>), upgrade fixture and tested rollback/restore references are absent.

findings.impact: No deterministic full migration/rollback/upgrade plan can be frozen for existing tenant data.

findings.title: Evidence-backed exclusions: The map says not to modify Transaction, native Stock, Automation and Facility Profile by d

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The map says not to modify Transaction, native Stock, Automation and Facility Profile by default. It does not provide the required per-consumer verified unchanged records, and Automation source demonstrably has affected message templates.

findings.impact: A no-change assumption would launder unresolved dependencies into code authorization.

findings.title: Blast-radius freshness: ZIP source map pins Staging@04bd0594; current Staging HEAD advanced three commits to 78476

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: ZIP source map pins Staging@04bd0594; current Staging HEAD advanced three commits to 78476d, changing seven CRM/material files. The listed Logistics/Documents owner files inspected here retain matching blob identity, but source currentness and any material-profile integration exclusion have not been recorded in the ZIP.

findings.impact: An operator could code against an obsolete baseline or assume changed source providers are independent without proof.

findings.title: Full change accounting / implementation planning: The old proposed addon filetree contains conditional booking_revision

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The old proposed addon filetree contains conditional booking_revision.py and a load_extension.py description centered on bookings with individual loads, while selected v2.7 E2/J1/E3 roles are stated elsewhere. This is historical/design-only, but the pre-code plan does not resolve whether each proposed file is kept, replaced, co-located or excluded.

findings.impact: An implementation agent reading both paths could choose conflicting field ownership or create surplus files.

findings.title: Fail-closed enforcement: POS-INV-26 remains a working DRAFT; INV-P16 is a written negative probe marked NOT_RUN; th

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: POS-INV-26 remains a working DRAFT; INV-P16 is a written negative probe marked NOT_RUN; the ZIP declares code blocked but does not contain an accepted revision-bound complete-plan receipt or an observed technical gate preventing unplanned edits.

findings.impact: Human/operator blocking instruction is explicit, but automatic repo/agent fail-closed enforcement cannot be claimed.

findings.title: Owner adoption / Enterprise compatibility: All seven EXP-IC contract handoffs have status NOT_ADOPTED and Enterprise tests are NOT_RU

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: All seven EXP-IC contract handoffs have status NOT_ADOPTED and Enterprise tests are NOT_RUN. J1/J2 and the 12 command signatures are specified as non-installed targets.

findings.impact: No downstream code may treat proposed interfaces as callable contracts or owner-approved schema.
